Package au.csiro.pathling.terminology.local

Class LocalTerminologyServiceFactory

java.lang.Object
au.csiro.pathling.terminology.local.LocalTerminologyServiceFactory
All Implemented Interfaces:
Configurable<TerminologyConfiguration>, TerminologyServiceFactory, Serializable
public final class LocalTerminologyServiceFactory extends Object implements TerminologyServiceFactory
A serialisable TerminologyServiceFactory that builds a LocalTerminologyService on each executor JVM, memoised once per distinct store configuration within the JVM. Unlike the remote factory, which permits only one configuration per process, local mode may legitimately work with more than one store in a single JVM (for example, when a process queries two stores in turn), so each distinct configuration keeps its own service.

The factory carries only serialisable state: the terminology configuration (including the local store path and cache settings) and a snapshot of the driver's Hadoop configuration, which carries spark.hadoop.* settings and credential providers so the store's filesystem is reachable on executors where a Hadoop Configuration is neither available nor serialisable.

Author:
John Grimes
